confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result (18 Nov 2026, 0.6720 USD per AUD). I ran one price search, and it returned crowdsourced Punta Cana prices. Some of those pages were dated as old as July 2023. They gave inexpensive meal about $7.30, mid-range meal for two about $61.85, cappuccino about $1.67 to $2.36, and domestic draught beer about $2.58. I set the beer anchor to about $3.50 because tourist-zone restaurant prices run above these figures. No cocktail price was found, so cocktail is estimated at about 2x beer. Wine by the glass is estimated at about 1.8x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no booking pages checked. Punta Cana is resort-dominated, so hostel and budget hotel supply is thin and those anchors are the most uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Caribbean and Latin American resort destinations such as Playa del Carmen and Cancun. Prices were set at tourist-zone levels, which are above the Dominican Republic average.
